chunks: And Hisham ibn Salim narrated from Abu Abdullah (عليه السلام), who said:
I asked him about someone who forgot the visitation of the House until he returned to his family, so he said: "It does not harm him if he has completed his rites."

key_terms.أَهْلِهِ: his family or household to whom he returned
key_terms.زِيَارَةَ الْبَيْتِ: the visitation of the Kaaba, meaning the prescribed hajj circumambulation
key_terms.لَا يَضُرُّهُ: it does not harm him; there is no detrimental consequence in this ruling
key_terms.مَنَاسِكَهُ: his pilgrimage rites and ritual acts of hajj
key_terms.نَسِيَ: forgot or failed to remember in time

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling if someone forgets ṭawāf al-ziyārah and returns to their family after completing the other hajj rites?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning one who forgot the ziyārah of the House during hajj and only remembered after returning home. Imam Abu Abdullah (عليه السلام) states that there is no harm upon such a person if the rest of the pilgrimage rites have already been completed.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.2784 - Hisham ibn Salim narrated from Abu Abdullah (as), who said:

I asked him about someone who forgot to perform the visitation of the Kaaba (Tawaf al-Ziyara) and returned to their family.
Imam (as) said: "It does not harm them if they have completed their other rites."
